# Vendored front-end libraries

Served from `/static/vendor` so MyLabVault works without internet access and pages make no third-party requests. Written by `scripts/vendor-assets.sh` (sources and versions are listed there; `SHA256SUMS` records the files). Don't edit these files by hand: change the version in the script and rerun it.

| Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|
| jQuery | 3.7.1 | MIT |
| Bootstrap (JS bundle) | 4.6.2 | MIT |
| AdminLTE | 3.2.0 | MIT |
| Chart.js | 4.4.0 | MIT |
| DataTables + Responsive (Bootstrap 4 styling) | 2.3.2 / 3.0.5 | MIT |
| Material Design Icons (webfont) | 7.4.47 | Apache 2.0 (icons), SIL OFL 1.1 (font) |
| IBM Plex Sans (400, 500, 600, 700; Latin + Latin Extended) | @fontsource 5.1.1 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
